metadata.title: असुर पूजा की परंपरा क्यों है | Koloi tribe : Customary Law and Religion | राई पूजा
metadata.description: Koloi is a group of people which belongs to the Halam tribe in Tripura. This tribe has it's own customary laws and belief system. Rai Balama Panda is an yearly puja performed at the home of the Raja of the community. In this Puja they worship Asur along with their deities. This is the first time the community has allowed a news channel to shoot the whole process and rituals of this Puja.
